clips.title: Number Ten discovery
clips.status: Whisper transcription checked against other passes and the game glossary; no human listening check.

subtitles.en:
An unprecedented astronomical
discovery was announced on Earth.

A mysterious planet had been found
far beyond Pluto.

Discovered at the edge of the solar system,
it seemed to have appeared from nowhere.

It was provisionally named "Number Ten,"
as the solar system's tenth planet.

Every kind of investigation
was launched from Earth...

but no detailed information
about the planet could be obtained.
